title: Roman Numeral Codec Both Ways

hidden.label: All six subtractive forms
hidden.expectedDisplay: IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM
hidden.script:
pairs = [(4,"IV"),(9,"IX"),(40,"XL"),(90,"XC"),(400,"CD"),(900,"CM")]
for val, txt in pairs:
    assert int_to_roman(val) == txt
    assert roman_to_int(txt) == val

hidden.label: Mixed complex numbers 444 and 2026
hidden.script:
assert int_to_roman(444) == "CDXLIV"
assert roman_to_int("CDXLIV") == 444
assert int_to_roman(2026) == "MMXXVI"
assert roman_to_int("MMXXVI") == 2026

hidden.label: Sweep all integers 1..200 round-trip
hidden.script:
for x in range(1, 201):
    assert roman_to_int(int_to_roman(x)) == x

hints: For int_to_roman, include subtractive tokens directly in descending table: [(1000,"M"), (900,"CM"), (500,"D"), (400,"CD"), ..., (4,"IV"), (1,"I")].
For roman_to_int, walk left to right: if current numeral value < next numeral value, subtract current; otherwise add current.
